title: Streamlining B2B Prospecting with Hunter
business: B2B sales development representatives and account executives
problem: Manual prospecting involves toggling between browser tabs to search for company domains, verify business information, and manually copy data into CRM systems, leading to significant context switching and data entry fatigue.
solution: The Hunter plugin integrates directly into the ChatGPT interface, allowing users to query company data, enrich business profiles, and organize prospect lists without leaving the chat environment, effectively centralizing the research workflow.
steps: Authenticate the Hunter plugin within the ChatGPT plugin store to link your account.
Submit a natural language prompt to identify companies based on specific industry or size criteria.
Review the returned company-level data and select high-value targets for enrichment.
Save the enriched company profiles directly to your internal tracking list or CRM via the plugin interface.
outcome: A seamless, consolidated research workflow that reduces manual data handling and increases the speed of building high-quality prospect lists.
limitation: The plugin relies on the availability and accuracy of data within the Hunter database; users should verify critical contact information by checking the source link provided in the output if data appears stale.
